lead_story: The Federal Reserve has held interest rates steady despite inflation concerns, causing a divided reaction among investors. This decision has led to a sell-off in Treasury yields and is being closely watched by markets. The Fed's inaction on interest rates is currently the biggest macro driver, with many investors waiting to see how it will impact the economy.
